entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, he just wants to get revenge on a guy[n]who made fun of him...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Didn't he give us some other weird[n]request too? Something about that[n]handsome actor?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is Mishima-kun trying to take advantage[n]of us?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Apparently, he has also threatened[n]anyone who dares speak ill of the[n]Phantom Thieves on his forum.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps we should enact a change of[n]heart on Mishima, not this Akiyama[n]fellow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa, wait up. He ain't that bad.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... I guess we could find out what's[n]happening if we managed to find his[n]Shadow.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I mean, he's already worried that we're[n]gonna change his heart, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll probably be able to track down[n]his Shadow in Mementos.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All things considered, I think our best[n]course of action would be to defeat it[n]and change his heart.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mishima-kun? It feels almost wrong to[n]consider such an option...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude... You've gotta be kiddin' me...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We can't have him keep causing[n]problems for us though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It may seem preposterous... but we[n]cannot allow him to disrupt our work.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either way, we can decide whether or[n]not we change his heart later. For now,[n]we must meet his Shadow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shouldn't we find his Shadow before[n]we start worrying about this stuff?
Let's go.
This is the only way...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah. Let's head into Mementos and[n]track down Mishima's Shadow!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So you wanna help that King dude out,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And we're gonna do it by changin' his[n]mom's heart?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I bet that was a real tough decision[n]to make.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, he's only in elementary school,[n]right? This is a lot for a little kid to be[n]dealing with...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right... We should try to help him[n]as soon as possible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As for the calling card, let's have him[n]deliver it himself.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So I guess this counts as a unanimous[n]decision?
